name: Andean Scapes golden conversation regression pack
strategyPrinciples: LLM owns reply text — no deterministic sales copy rewriting
Safety and compliance guards remain active
Deterministic evaluation validates state, flags, math, and leak guards
Live evaluation validates copy quality, brevity, conversion rhythm, and trust
implementationNotes: Core scenarios are grounded in the full conversation export from 2026-08-02; six scenarios cover C/H/R campaign markers.
Live-tagged message scenarios carry minLiveScore plus copy-quality criteria for bounded real-LLM runs.
Follow-up scenarios were removed with the automated follow-up feature.
price_after_min_fields counts name/people/date/transport only — plan is not a counted field, so quote scenarios gated on people+plan use minFields 1 and assert the plan question separately.
Couple quotes assert the exact total instead of group_quote_integrity: the model says 'ustedes dos' rather than '2 personas', which is better copy and not a defect.
Entry segment expansion: H02 (funnel 4x4), R03 (retarget moto), and generic H01/R01 ensure vehicle-context and blocker-recall testing across themes.
